title.en: Yamaha NMAX's cylinder has no iron liner inside 😳 #shorts
title.id: Silinder Yamaha NMAX nggak pakai liner besi 😳 #shorts

description.en: The Blue Core 155 engine in the Yamaha NMAX uses Yamaha's DiASil cylinder: an all-aluminium cylinder die-cast from an alloy with about 20% silicon, with no iron or steel sleeve. Without the sleeve it is lighter and sheds heat well. Yamaha developed DiASil in 2002.
description.id: Mesin Blue Core 155 di Yamaha NMAX pakai silinder DiASil: silinder full aluminium hasil die-cast dari paduan dengan sekitar 20% silikon, tanpa liner besi. Tanpa liner, silinder lebih ringan dan panasnya cepat dibuang. Yamaha mengembangkan DiASil sejak 2002.

scenes.en: The cylinder in a Yamaha NMAX has *no iron liner*. The piston runs on aluminium.
scenes.id: Silinder Yamaha NMAX *nggak pakai liner besi*. Pistonnya langsung jalan di aluminium.

scenes.en: Most engines press a *cast-iron sleeve* into an aluminium cylinder, because plain aluminium is too soft to rub against all day.
scenes.id: Kebanyakan mesin pakai *liner besi cor* di dalam silinder aluminium, karena aluminium biasa terlalu lunak buat terus digesek.

scenes.en: Yamaha's *DiASil* cylinder skips it. It's die-cast from aluminium mixed with about *20 percent silicon*.
scenes.id: Silinder *DiASil* Yamaha nggak pakai itu. Dicetak dari aluminium yang dicampur sekitar *20 persen silikon*.

scenes.en: The hard silicon lets the piston rings run *right on the cylinder wall*.
scenes.id: Silikon yang keras bikin ring piston bisa jalan *langsung di dinding silinder*.

scenes.en: No sleeve means a *lighter* cylinder, and with no iron layer in the way, it sheds *heat* well.
scenes.id: Tanpa liner, silinder jadi *lebih ringan*, dan tanpa lapisan besi, *panasnya* cepat dibuang.

scenes.en: It sits inside the NMAX's *Blue Core 155*, and Yamaha first developed it back in *2002*.
scenes.id: Teknologi ini ada di mesin *Blue Core 155* NMAX, dan Yamaha pertama mengembangkannya tahun *2002*.

scenes.en: Send this to someone who *rides an NMAX*.
scenes.id: Kirim ini ke temanmu yang *pakai NMAX*.
